title: Kiongozi Aliyeteuliwa wa Taifa
intro: Katika wakati wa changamoto kubwa na kukata tamaa kwa watu, miadi ya kimungu ilifanywa. Mtu huyu, ambaye mwanzoni alipuuzwa na wengi, alichaguliwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kuongoza taifa dhidi ya adui mkubwa. Hadithi yao ni ushuhuda wa nguvu ya imani na hekima iliyo nyuma ya amri ya kimungu, ikionyesha kwamba uongozi wa kweli haupatikani kila wakati katika maeneo yanayotarajiwa.
clues: Nilichaguliwa na Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa kiongozi wa watu wangu walipomtafuta mtawala wa kupigana katika njia yake.
Mwanzoni watu wangu walitilia shaka uteuzi wangu, wakihisi kwamba wengine walikuwa wanastahili zaidi kutokana na utajiri au ukoo wao.
Ishara ya uongozi wangu halali ilikuwa kurudi kwa sanduku takatifu, lililokuwa na mabaki ya manabii waliopita, ambayo yalileta utulivu.
Niliongoza jeshi langu hadi mtoni, ambapo nilijaribu utii wao kwa kuwakataza kunywa zaidi ya kijiko kimoja cha maji.
Licha ya idadi ndogo ya wale waliobaki imara baada ya jaribio, tulikabiliana na shujaa hodari na jeshi lake.
Chini ya amri yangu, kijana mmoja kutoka jeshi langu, ambaye hakuwa mpiganaji mashuhuri, alikabiliana na kumshinda kwa ujasiri bingwa wa adui mwenye nguvu.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
